```{r}
con = DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "../data/midwest_airbnb.db")
listings = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "listings")

nrow(listings)
sum(listings$city == "Columbus")
nrow(subset(listings, city == "Columbus"))
chicago <- subset(listings, city == "Chicago")
head(chicago[order(chicago$price, decreasing = TRUE), c("name", "price")], 1)
length(unique(chicago$neighbourhood))
sum(listings$host_is_superhost == "t", na.rm = TRUE)
sum(listings$price > 1000, na.rm = TRUE)
DBI::dbReadTable(con, "listings")
```
